verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's changelog says Business and Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data beyond the retention period. That is a first-party data-portability feature, but it covers only Insights event data on higher tiers, and the snippet is truncated, so the destination and format are unstated. The faults and projects read APIs expose some error data, but they are building blocks rather than a documented export-everything feature. GitHub/Jira issue exports are an adjacent ticketing feature and earn no credit. missing for 10: a documented full-account export of errors, notices, logs, uptime and check-in data, confirmation of open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/Parquet), availability on all plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful export-and-leave.
